marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Laxmi Narayan 1 is a young aspiring shooter from the underworld whose only aim is to fulfill his mother's dream of becoming the most popular don. Laxmi Narayan 2 is an automobile salesman from Mumbai whose only aim in life is to keep his boss happy. He has only two rules in life: Rule 1: The boss is always right. Rule 2: If the boss is wrong, follow Rule 1. Laxmi Narayan 3 is a rich but poor man who is in the lingerie business. He sells his wares in a mobile car on the streets of Chandni Chowk in Delhi. All three reach a place called Pondyon a different mission. But what follows is total chaos and confusion
